verdict_reason: Repaired and verified against the RELEASED SOURCE, not against a reviewer's claim. I had reverted this same repair on 2026-09-07 conditioned on someone running the released topnn_framework loader -- correct caution, since the analogous magnipy de-duplication claim was refuted by execution. The condition is now met by reading the released code: transformers/betti_calc_parallel.py's read_csv does data = np.unique(np.transpose(np.array(data)), axis=0), i.e. it de-duplicates the POINTS before choosing k or building the neighbour graph. After applying np.unique(X, axis=0) a 42-point circle and the same circle plus 5 exact copies give IDENTICAL Betti numbers, and the disputed 13-row fixture gives beta_0 = 1, matching the released route (6 unique points -> 1 component) and GUDHI's single infinite H0 interval.

It is applied anyway because the released reference defines this statistic and makes the other choice; the disagreement is documented at the call site rather than resolved silently in the mathematics' favour.
